report_type: US actionable earnings window full ranked report
market_context_summary: August CPI is due before the September 11 open, overlapping Kroger's reaction window and creating rate sensitivity for software valuations.

methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 dispersion index based on the spread and average absolute deviation of three direction and reversal-risk estimates; lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_update: No new method change; existing expectation-bar, decisive-metric, forward-look, and reversal-risk controls were applied.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY26 outlook and second-half revenue bridge
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: RH's flat first-half setup leaves a demanding second-half acceleration and margin bridge exposed to housing, tariff, and execution risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue growth 0.5%-2.5% and adjusted EBITDA margin 11.5%-13.0%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog conversion, stronger demand, and maintained 4.5%-8.0% FY revenue growth support relief upside.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A weaker demand read or reduced second-half guide undermines the 12% second-half growth bridge.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move verified; depressed shares and 44x trailing P/E create two-way risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus remains cautious as housing and sourcing pressures offset global expansion.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: OCI growth, capex, and funding quality
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Backlog conversion beats the high bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: OCI growth can be excellent while shares still fall if margins, capex, funding, or Q2 guidance fail to validate the $638B backlog.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $19.1B revenue, $1.74-$1.78 adjusted EPS, and 58%-64% cloud growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: OCI growth above 100%, strong RPO conversion, and disciplined capex commentary validate AI demand.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: More capex or financing, weak margins, or merely in-line cloud growth reinforce negative free-cash-flow concerns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Intense AI positioning; no precise current implied move was independently verified.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Buy consensus and high targets contrast with a falling pre-print share price and demanding bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Soft monthly comps and cautious consumer conditions tilt down, but a low loss estimate creates substantial squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Lower year-over-year earnings and revenue; company guided Q2 EPS to a $0.23-$0.08 loss.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Positive comps and better Q3 guidance clear a low bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Negative comps and weak back-to-school commentary extend the earnings decline.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Thin liquidity and small market cap can amplify either direction.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Digital Media ARR and FY26 outlook
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Low valuation and quantified AI traction support upside if ARR and FY26 targets hold, but another beat without stronger forward proof may sell off.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $6.69B revenue and $6.08 adjusted EPS; ending ARR growth guide is 10.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR and Firefly monetization exceed the bar with a maintained or raised outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ARR deceleration or cautious successor commentary triggers a third post-beat selloff.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Published estimates disagree between roughly 5.4% and 9% implied move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Hold consensus and a recent Sell/$240 reiteration show skepticism.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Flat growth and weaker auction economics
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Modest volume growth and better gross-profit conversion offer a contained upside edge if auction economics remain firm.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Volume recovery and gross-profit growth outpace revenue.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Flat units, lower selling prices, or yard costs reverse the edge.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One preview indicates a contained move; source quality is moderate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Target dispersion is wide; no robust short-window revision series verified.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Identical sales ex-fuel and FY guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Stable food demand leans positive, but a narrow sales guide, pharmacy dynamics, and same-morning CPI keep the setup below actionable strength.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $34.6B revenue, $1.05-$1.06 EPS; FY identical sales ex-fuel guide 1%-2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comps beat and FY guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Traffic, price investment, or pharmacy margins offset a beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Recent average earnings reaction cited near 6.1%; same-morning CPI adds factor risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: 11 Buy and 13 Hold ratings; targets imply upside but revisions are mixed.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic services growth and EBITDA margin
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Recurring logistics software growth is durable, but acquisition effects and valuation leave insufficient evidence for a directional edge.

ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic services growth and margins accelerate.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Organic growth slows or acquisition costs dilute quality.
